description:
Lists all available Novada tools — name, description, category, group, and status. Useful at the start of a task to find the right tool, or whenever another tool's description isn't enough to decide between two options.

**Returns:** a markdown table grouped by category, plus a Tool Groups reference (core/scrapers/account/meta).
**Filter:** category narrows the catalog (e.g. category="Proxy"); NOVADA_GROUPS/NOVADA_TOOLS (local) or ?groups=/?tools= (hosted) narrow the actual tool set exposed on this connection.
**Status:** active = available now. Output includes server_version.

**Auth:** a single NOVADA_API_KEY authenticates search/extract/research/crawl/scrape/unblock/proxy auto-provisioning — no separate keys needed. NOVADA_BROWSER_WS/NOVADA_PROXY_ENDPOINT unlock extras, no extra key. See novada_account (section="summary") for balance/plans/entitlements.

category.description: Optional category filter. One of: 'Content Retrieval', 'Scraping & Verification', 'Proxy', 'Browser & Rendering', 'Account & Billing', 'Health & Discovery'. Omit to list all tools.

platform.description: Optional platform domain to look up (e.g. 'amazon.com', 'tiktok.com'). When provided, returns all operations for that platform from the scraper catalog — free, no API call, no credit cost. Mutually exclusive with category: if both are provided, platform takes priority.

name: novada_discover
title: Tool Discovery
